Quiz & Larossi: Production duo of Andreas Romdhane and Josef Larossi. Made songs for Westlife, Leona Lewis and Kelly Clarkson.
Pontus Winnberg: The other half of Bloodshy & Avant, who made Toxic for Britney Spears and songs for Madonna and Kylie Minogue. Member of Miike Snow.

Anders Bagge: Songwriter and producer who has written for Madonna, Celine Dion and Janet Jackson.

Jake Schulze: Cheiron producer on records by Backstreet Boys, Britney Spears and NSYNC.
Max Martin: Went from the hard rock band It's Alive to Denniz Pop's Cheiron studio in Stockholm in the mid-90s. Has since written and produced hits for Backstreet Boys, Britney Spears, Katy Perry, Taylor Swift, The Weeknd and Ariana Grande, and has more Billboard number ones as a songwriter than almost anyone in history.
David Kreuger: Songwriter and producer who often works with Per Magnusson. Made songs for Westlife, Celine Dion and Britney Spears.
Benny Andersson: Composer and pianist in ABBA. Wrote nearly all ABBA songs with Björn Ulvaeus, and later the musicals Chess and Kristina från Duvemåla.
Björn Ulvaeus: Guitarist and lyricist in ABBA, songwriting partner of Benny Andersson. Co-creator of the Mamma Mia! musical.
Stig Anderson: ABBA's manager and publisher. Wrote lyrics for early ABBA songs such as Waterloo and Ring Ring.
ABBA: Agnetha Fältskog, Björn Ulvaeus, Benny Andersson and Anni-Frid Lyngstad. Won Eurovision 1974 with Waterloo and became Sweden's biggest music export.
Joey Tempest: Singer and songwriter in Europe. Wrote The Final Countdown.
Europe: Hard rock band from Upplands Väsby whose The Final Countdown topped charts around the world in 1986.
Mic Michaeli: Keyboardist and songwriter in the hard rock band Europe.
Neneh Cherry: Artist who broke through in the UK with Buffalo Stance in 1988, and 7 Seconds with Youssou N'Dour.
Per Gessle: Songwriter and singer in Roxette and Gyllene Tider. Wrote The Look, Listen to Your Heart and It Must Have Been Love.
Roxette: Per Gessle and Marie Fredriksson. Four Billboard number ones, including The Look and It Must Have Been Love.
Mats \"MP\" Persson: Musician and producer, member of Gyllene Tider.
Denniz Pop: Founded the Cheiron studio in Stockholm in 1992 and laid the foundation for Swedish pop exports with Dr. Alban, Ace of Base and Backstreet Boys. Mentor to Max Martin. Died 1998.
Dr. Alban: Dentist turned artist who moved to Sweden and made It's My Life and Sing Hallelujah with Denniz Pop.
Alexander Bard: Member of Army of Lovers and BWO.

Jonas Berggren: Songwriter in Ace of Base. Wrote The Sign and All That She Wants.
Ulf Ekberg: Member and songwriter in Ace of Base.

Laila El Khalifi: Artist known as Leila K, with Plastic Dreams and Got to Get.
Douglas Carr: Swedish pop and dance producer and songwriter.
Christian Falk: Producer for Neneh Cherry and Robyn.
Rednex: The group behind Cotton Eye Joe in 1994.
John Amatiello: Cheiron producer and part of the production pair Amadin.
Kristian Lundin: Cheiron producer. Worked on Backstreet Boys, NSYNC (Bye Bye Bye), Celine Dion (That's the Way It Is) and Britney Spears.
Tommy Ekman: Swedish songwriter and producer who often works with Per Adebratt.
Per Adebratt: Swedish songwriter and producer who often works with Tommy Ekman.
Per Magnusson: Songwriter and producer, often paired with David Kreuger. Songs for Westlife, Britney Spears and Celine Dion.
Peter Svensson: Guitarist in The Cardigans who became one of Max Martin's collaborators. Has written for The Weeknd (Can't Feel My Face) and Ariana Grande.
Tore Johansson: Malmö producer behind The Cardigans' records and Franz Ferdinand.
The Cardigans: Band from Jönköping that broke through with Lovefool and My Favourite Game.
Robyn: Artist who broke through in the US in 1997 with Show Me Love and Do You Know (What It Takes), and had a second career with Dancing On My Own.
Cia Berg: Swedish singer and TV host, known from the band Whale.
Eagle-Eye Cherry: Artist whose Save Tonight became a worldwide hit in 1998.
Andreas Carlsson: Cheiron songwriter who wrote I Want It That Way with Max Martin and Bye Bye Bye for NSYNC, plus songs for Celine Dion and Bon Jovi.
Klas Åhlund: Guitarist in Teddybears and producer. Made much of Robyn's music, including the album Robyn and With Every Heartbeat, and has written for Britney Spears, Katy Perry and Usher.
Jörgen Elofsson: Songwriter from Skåne. Wrote Britney Spears' (You Drive Me) Crazy and Sometimes, Westlife hits like My Love, and Kelly Clarkson's A Moment Like This.
Martina Axén: Drummer in the Stockholm rock band Drain STH.
Lisa Miskovsky: Artist and songwriter who has written for Backstreet Boys.
Mauro Scocco: Swedish singer, songwriter and producer, known from Ratata and a long solo career.
Nick Jarl: Swedish producer and songwriter working in Stockholm since the 1990s.
Patric Jonsson: Swedish songwriter with several Melodifestivalen entries.
Randy Fitzsimmons: The fictional songwriter credited on The Hives' songs.
The Hives: Garage rock band from Fagersta. Hate to Say I Told You So.
Per Sunding: Swedish musician and producer, formerly of the band Eskobar.
Carl Falk: Songwriter and producer. Wrote One Direction's What Makes You Beautiful with Rami Yacoub and Savan Kotecha, and worked with Avicii and Madonna.
Henrik Jonback: Guitarist and producer from the Cheiron circle. Co-writer of Britney Spears' Toxic and Galantis songs.
Eric Prydz: DJ and producer. Call on Me was a UK number one in 2004.
Ana Johnsson: Pop singer and songwriter from Gothenburg, known for We Are.
Axwell: DJ and producer, member of Swedish House Mafia and Axwell & Ingrosso. Behind Sun Is Shining and Don't You Worry Child.
Camela Leierth: Swedish singer and songwriter, guest vocalist on Kent's Generation Ex.
Mattman & Robin: Stockholm production duo. Made songs for Taylor Swift, Selena Gomez, Britney Spears and Justin Bieber, and won a Grammy for Taylor Swift's 1989.
Alexandra Talomaa: Swedish songwriter who has written for Backstreet Boys and A*Teens, among others.
Karin Dreijer: One half of The Knife, also known as Fever Ray.
The Knife: Sibling duo whose Heartbeats became world famous in José González's version.
Steve Angello: DJ and producer, member of Swedish House Mafia. Born in Greece and raised in Stockholm.
Basshunter: Producer and artist from Halmstad. Boten Anna and All I Ever Wanted were big hits in Europe.
Patrik Berger: Producer who made Robyn's Dancing On My Own and Icona Pop's I Love It.
José González: Artist known for his version of The Knife's Heartbeats.
Linda Sundblad: Swedish singer and songwriter, formerly of the band Lambretta.
Tobias Karlsson: Swedish songwriter and producer who has written for Halsey and Adam Lambert, among others.
Björn Yttling: Member of Peter Bjorn and John and producer for Lykke Li.
Peter Morén: Singer and guitarist in Peter Bjorn and John.
John Eriksson: Drummer in Peter Bjorn and John.
Peter Bjorn and John: Indie band whose Young Folks became an international hit in 2006.
Oscar Görres: Songwriter and producer in the Wolf Cousins circle. Works with The Weeknd, Ariana Grande, Troye Sivan and Sabrina Carpenter, among others.
Fredrik Kempe: Songwriter behind many Melodifestivalen and Eurovision entries.
Henrik Wikström: Swedish songwriter and producer with many Melodifestivalen entries.
AJ Junior: Sweden-based songwriter and producer who wrote On the Floor for Jennifer Lopez.
Sebastian Ingrosso: DJ and producer, member of Swedish House Mafia and Axwell & Ingrosso.
Salem Al Fakir: Artist and songwriter. Wrote Hey Brother and several other songs with Avicii.
Robert Uhlmann: Swedish producer who has worked with Dr. Alban, Arash and Basshunter, among others.
Andreas Kleerup: Producer and artist, made With Every Heartbeat with Robyn.
Shellback: Started as a hard rock musician in Karlshamn and became Max Martin's closest partner from 2008. Behind Pink's So What, Taylor Swift's We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together and Shake It Off, and Maroon 5's Moves like Jagger.
Bobby Ljunggren: Swedish songwriter and producer with a record number of Melodifestivalen entries.
Peer Åström: Swedish producer and songwriter who has worked with Madonna and Glee, among others.
Johan Bobäck: Swedish songwriter and producer who has written for Carola and other schlager artists.
Ilya: Producer and songwriter in Max Martin's Wolf Cousins circle. Made many of Ariana Grande's biggest songs, including Problem, Bang Bang and God Is a Woman, and Ellie Goulding's Love Me Like You Do.
Oscar Holter: Producer in Wolf Cousins. Made The Weeknd's Blinding Lights with Max Martin, and songs for Taylor Swift, Katy Perry and Troye Sivan.
Sofi Bonde: Pop singer and songwriter born in Gothenburg in 1976.
Malena Ernman: Swedish opera singer who won Melodifestivalen 2009 with La voix.
Ludwig Göransson: Composer and producer. Made Childish Gambino's This Is America and the music for Black Panther, The Mandalorian and Oppenheimer, winning Oscars for both Black Panther and Oppenheimer.
Linus Eklöw: Producer under the name Style of Eye and member of Galantis. Wrote Icona Pop's I Love It.
Peter Boström: Swedish songwriter and producer, co-writer of Euphoria.
Swedish House Mafia: Axwell, Steve Angello and Sebastian Ingrosso. The world's best-known house trio, with Don't You Worry Child and Save the World.
Avicii: DJ and producer who became a global star with Levels in 2011 and Wake Me Up in 2013. Mixed house with country and folk, and also wrote for Coldplay and Madonna. Died 2018.
Ash Pournouri: Avicii's manager and co-writer on several of his early hits.
Sophia Somajo: Stockholm singer and songwriter who has written for international pop artists.
John Martin: Swedish singer and songwriter, known from Swedish House Mafia's Don't You Worry Child.
Lykke Li: Artist. I Follow Rivers was a European hit in 2011.
Adam Anders: Swedish-born producer and songwriter, known as music producer for Glee.
Icona Pop: Caroline Hjelt and Aino Jawo. I Love It became a worldwide hit in 2012.
Vincent Pontare: Songwriter and artist (Salem Al Fakir's partner) who wrote Hey Brother and several other Avicii songs.
Ali Payami: Producer and songwriter in Wolf Cousins. Made Taylor Swift's Style and The Weeknd's In the Night, among others.
Oligee: Stockholm producer and songwriter who has worked with Kylie Minogue and Ellie Goulding.
Alesso: DJ and producer. Heroes with Tove Lo and the Calvin Harris collaboration Under Control.
Thomas G:son: Swedish songwriter known for many Melodifestivalen entries, including Euphoria.
Noonie Bao: Artist and songwriter. Has written for Charli XCX and Avicii, among others.
Linus Wiklund: Swedish producer and songwriter who has worked with Veronica Maggio and Lana Del Rey, among others.
Jakke Erixson: Swedish songwriter and producer who has written for Kylie Minogue, among others.
Otto Knows: DJ and producer, known for Million Voices.
Tove Lo: Artist and songwriter. Broke through with Habits (Stay High) and has written for Ellie Goulding (Love Me Like You Do), Hilary Duff and Girls Aloud.
Veronica Maggio: Pop artist and songwriter from Uppsala.
Jason Gill: Swedish producer and songwriter who has worked with Veronica Maggio.
Johan Carlsson: Swedish producer and songwriter who has worked with Ariana Grande and Maroon 5, among others.
Lucas Nordqvist: Swedish producer and songwriter who has worked with Miguel and Jhené Aiko, among others.
Rickard Göransson: Guitarist and songwriter in Max Martin's team.
Hamed Pirouzpanah: Swedish producer and songwriter, also known as K-One.
Svidden: Producer and songwriter who has worked with Galantis and Icona Pop.
Peter Carlsson: Swedish producer and engineer from the Stockholm pop scene.
Julia Karlsson: Swedish songwriter who has written for international pop artists.
Galantis: The duo Christian Karlsson and Linus Eklöw. Runaway (U & I) and No Money.
Zara Larsson: Artist who won Talang in 2008 and had worldwide hits with Lush Life, Never Forget You and Symphony.
Jonnali Parmenius: Swedish songwriter and singer who has written for Becky Hill, among others.
Ghost: Hard rock band from Linköping led by Tobias Forge.
Rasmus Flyckt: Swedish producer and songwriter who has worked with Tove Lo and Zara Larsson, among others.
Sandro Cavazza: Artist and songwriter, sang on Avicii's Without You.
Dhani Lennevald: Swedish singer and songwriter, formerly in A*Teens.
Tobias Jimson: Swedish songwriter and producer who has worked with Tove Lo, among others.
Astma & Rocwell: Stockholm production duo who have worked with Selena Gomez, among others.
Joy Deb: Swedish songwriter and producer, behind several Melodifestivalen entries.
Linnea Deb: Swedish songwriter who co-wrote Heroes for Måns Zelmerlöw.
Laleh: Singer, songwriter and producer, born in Iran and raised in Gothenburg.
Emanuel Abrahamsson: Swedish songwriter and producer who has worked with Laleh.
Kristoffer Fogelmark: Songwriter who has worked with Avicii.
Albin Nedler: Songwriter who has worked with Avicii.
Daniel Adams-Ray: Swedish artist and songwriter, formerly in Snook.
Frej Larsson: Stockholm rapper, songwriter and producer, known from Maskinen among others.
Felix Flygare Floderer: Stockholm songwriter and producer with credits for Avicii, Veronica Maggio and Astrid S.
Carl Silvergran: Songwriter trained at Musikmakarna who co-wrote Victor Leksell's Svag.
Sibel Redžep: Singer and songwriter who has competed in Melodifestivalen.
Anton Mårtensson: Songwriter and producer, also working as Hybrid, with credits for Agnes among others.
Isak Alverus: Songwriter and producer who has written for Avicii, Seinabo Sey, Agnes and Victor Leksell.
Little Jinder: Stockholm artist, songwriter and producer performing as Little Jinder.
Elvira Anderfjärd: Swedish producer and songwriter who has worked with Kelly Clarkson and BENEE, among others.
Jonas W. Karlsson: Songwriter and producer of international pop and dance songs.
Max Grahn: Songwriter and producer at MXM who has written for Ghost, Conan Gray and Kim Petras.
Gustav Weber Vernét: Keyboardist and musical director for Tove Lo, trained at RML in Stockholm.
MTHR: Production duo of Karl Ivert and Kian Sang who have worked with Zara Larsson.
Jimmy Thörnfeldt: Songwriter and producer of Melodifestivalen entries and international pop.
Jimmy Jansson: Swedish songwriter and producer, prolific in Melodifestivalen.
Cazzi Opeia: Songwriter and artist who has written for Lady Gaga and Little Mix, among others.
Kamilla Bayrak: Sweden-based topliner and songwriter (artist name Mila Josef) who has written for Armin van Buuren and Agnetha Fältskog.
Joakim Åhlund: Stockholm musician, songwriter and producer, known from Caesars and Teddybears.
Tove Burman: Songwriter and artist who has written for international pop artists.
Martin Stilling: Producer and songwriter who has worked with Léon, Sigrid, Veronica Maggio and Charli XCX.
